title: Copilot Golden Set
description: Regression test set for Copilot correctness. Each question asserts tool selection + answer shape.

id.description: Stable identifier for the test case (e.g., 'bug-b-gummy-hashables')

question.description: Natural-language prompt sent to the Copilot

notes.description: Why this test exists — link to bug or user story

expectedTools.description: Tools that MUST be called (subset match — others may also be invoked)

forbiddenTools.description: Tools that MUST NOT be called (e.g., search_packages for a count query)

expectContains.description: Substrings that must appear in the response (case-insensitive)

expectNumericNear.description: A number that must appear in the response within ±tolerance * value

maxDurationMs.description: Test fails if response takes longer than this (default 10000)

skip.description: Temporarily skip this test (with a reason in notes)
